summary: The usage report no longer under-counts cost and over-counts people behind an LLM gateway or with background subagents: cache writes reported as a total without a split by duration are priced as 5-minute writes instead of dropped, and a subagent handing its report back to the session is counted as a system turn, so it no longer adds human prompts, human interactions or human thinking time. Applies to sessions recorded from this version on.
